description: This file defines an Angular component named SidebarComponent, which provides a UI sidebar for search input and folder/tag filtering. It emits events to communicate user actions (create, search, filter change) to parent components.

classes.name: SidebarComponent
classes.description: An Angular component managing sidebar UI features for search and folder/tag filtering, emitting events based on user interactions.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates the search query signal and emits a search event when the search input changes.

methods.name: setFolder
methods.description: Sets the selected folder and emits a filter change event with current tag selection.

methods.name: setTag
methods.description: Sets the selected tag and emits a filter change event with current folder selection.
